title: DECLARE THIS OVER YOUR MORNING BEFORE THE DEVIL STEALS YOUR DAY
text: Lift your hands wherever you are. Just lift your hands right now. Father, we thank you. We thank you for this moment. We thank you because you are a God who does not sleep, a God who does not slumber, a God who is perpetually mindful of your people. Lord, we receive this moment as a gift. We receive this atmosphere as an invitation. Holy Spirit, take over. Take over completely. Let every word that proceeds from this altar be a word that carries life, that carries fire, that carries transformation in Jesus' mighty name. Somebody shout amen. Be seated. Be seated in the presence of God. I want you to take this message and share it. Please share it. Do not hoard what God is about to do in your life. There is someone, I don't know who it is, I don't know where they are, but there is someone who is on the edge. They are on the verge of giving up on their morning, giving up on their day, giving up on their life, and God is going to use you, yes, you, as the instrument through which this word reaches them. The moment you share this, you are not just forwarding a video, you are forwarding a lifeline. You are extending a rope to a drowning soul. Share it. Let it travel. Let it go to the ends of the earth. God wants to use ordinary vessels to carry extraordinary fire. Now, listen to me. I want you to settle something in your spirit before we begin. The morning is not just a time of day. Hear me. The morning is a portal. The morning is a gate. The morning is the threshold between what was everything that happened yesterday, everything that tried to destroy you in the night season, and what shall be. What God ordained for you to walk in. The morning is where heaven interfaces with earth in a very particular way, and the enemy knows this. This is why the devil is strategic about your mornings. He is strategic about how your day begins because he understands something that many believers do not yet understand that the first moments of the day set a spiritual frequency, they set a tone, they set a trajectory. And what you declare, what you declare in your morning determines what opens and what closes over your day. Turn with me to the book of Psalms chapter 5 verse 3. Psalms chapter 5 verse 3. David, that man who understood prophetic warfare, that man who understood that prayer was not a religious exercise but a weapon, that man who had been haunted and had stood against giants, David said, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." Did you see that? "In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee." The word direct there in the original Hebrew, it carries the idea of arrangement, of setting in order like a priest arranging the sacrifice on an altar. David was saying, "In the morning, I arrange my life before you. I set my affairs in order in your presence. I align my day with your agenda before the world can touch me, before the enemy can reach me, before the noise can drown out your voice, I direct, I arrange, I set." And then he says something that wrecks me every time I read it, "And will look up." After I have directed my prayer, I will look up. I will wait in expectation. I will position myself as a man who is confident that what I sent into the heavens is already working, already moving, already shifting things on my behalf. This is the posture of a morning warrior. Now, turn with me to one more scripture before we go deeper. Mark chapter 1 verse 35. Mark chapter 1 verse 35. Even Jesus the son of God, the one in whom all the fullness of the Godhead dwelt bodily, even he understood the power of the morning. The scripture says, "And in the morning rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed." A great while before day, before the disciples woke up, before the crowds gathered, before the demands came. Before the noise of ministry, the pressure of miracles, the weight of human need, before all of that Jesus slipped away into the solitary place and he prayed. If the son of God needed to secure his morning, what makes you think you can afford to skip yours? If the one who spoke the world into existence still went into the secret place before he stepped into the day, what are you doing scrolling through your phone before you've talked to your father? Listen carefully. The devil is not random. He's not haphazard. He doesn't wake up in the morning and say, "Let me see who I can disturb today." No. The scripture says in 1 Peter chapter 5 verse 8, "Be sober, be vigilant because your adversary, the devil, as a roaring lion walketh about seeking whom he may devour." He is seeking. He has a strategy. He has a plan for your day. He has an assignment against your morning. And his first goal is not to kill you outright. His first goal is to steal your day, to steal your hours, to steal your momentum, to steal your peace, to steal your focus, to steal your faith. And if he can steal enough days, he can steal your destiny. But I came to tell somebody today, this day does not belong to the devil. This morning is not his property. Your peace is not his to take. Your destiny is not available for theft. And we are going to declare it. We are going to establish it. We are going to drive stakes into the ground of this day and say, "Devil, you are trespassing. This territory belongs to the Lord." Now, let me teach you something for a moment. There are dimensions to morning warfare that most believers have never explored. The first dimension is the dimension of consecration. When you wake up in the morning before anything else, you are supposed to consecrate yourself, to set yourself apart, to say, "I belong to God. This day belongs to God. My breath belongs to God. My thoughts belong to God. My plans belong to God." This is not a ritual. This is a realignment. It is a spiritual repositioning. It is you saying to the forces of darkness, "I am not accessible to you. I am covered. I am sealed. I am under authority." The second dimension is the dimension of declaration. Proverbs chapter 18 verse 21, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." Your tongue is a weapon. Your tongue is a creative instrument. What you say in the morning, and I mean literally, the first words out of your mouth carry spiritual weight. If the first thing you say is a complaint, you have opened a door to the spirit of murmuring. If the first thing you say is a declaration of God's goodness, you have opened a door to the manifold blessing of God. The third dimension is the dimension of spiritual warfare. Because the night season is when the enemy operates most aggressively. While you sleep, there are battles being fought over your life. There are altars being activated against you. There are covenants being invoked. There are words being spoken. And when you wake up in the morning without engaging in warfare, you walk into your day already under siege, already bound, already carrying weights that were placed on you in the night. This is why some people wake up and they cannot explain why they feel heavy. They cannot explain why there is dread. They cannot explain the anxiety. It is because the night shift of the enemy worked overtime and they haven't yet used their authority to dismantle what was set against them. But when you wake up with the word in your mouth, when you wake up with fire in your spirit, when you wake up declaring the blood of Jesus over every assignment, everything that was arranged against you in the night is dismantled before it can manifest in your day. I want to preach this deeply for a moment. The Bible says in Lamentations chapter 3 verse 22 and 23, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness. New every morning." Every morning is a fresh dispensation of mercy. Every morning heaven releases a new package of grace. Every morning there is a fresh outpouring of divine resources specifically designated for your life. And the question is, will you receive it? Will you position yourself to receive the new thing that God has prepared for this morning? But here is what the enemy does. He tries to contaminate the morning before you can receive the fresh mercy. He tries to bring yesterday's pain into today's morning. He tries to bring last week's failure into this moment. He tries to bring the voice of old accusations, old shame, old guilt, old regret and drown out the voice of God that is saying, "My mercies are new. My compassions are fresh. Today is different. Today is the day I turn your situation around." So your declaration in the morning is also a declaration of reception. You are saying, "I receive the new mercy. I receive the fresh grace. I I the recycled pain. I reject the old narrative. I step into the new thing that God has prepared. Now, thus said the spirit of God to someone under the sound of my voice today, the morning you have been dreading has become the morning of your breakthrough. The day you thought would be another chapter of your suffering is the day God has chosen to turn the page. The turning point is not next month. The turning point is not when your situation looks better. The turning point is now. It is in this moment of declaration. It is in this moment of faith. Rise. Open your mouth and declare. Let me take you to the book of Isaiah for a moment. Isaiah chapter 54, verse 17. No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord. This is the heritage. The heritage, not a blessing, not an occasional visitation. The heritage meaning it is the standing inheritance of every child of God. No weapon. No weapon formed against you shall prosper. Not the weapon of sickness, not the weapon of poverty, not the weapon of witchcraft, not the weapon of marital destruction, not the weapon of delayed destiny. Not the weapon of financial embargo, not the weapon of ancestral limitation. No weapon. None. But here is the part that people miss. Every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn. You shall condemn it. Not God automatically condemning it on your behalf while you remain passive. You. You shall condemn every tongue that rises. Which means your tongue in response is the weapon of condemnation. Your declaration is the instrument through which the enemy's assignment is dismantled. This is why the morning declaration is so critical. When you declare over your morning, you are condemning every tongue that rose in the night. You are silencing every voice that spoke against your day before you woke up. You are neutralizing every word of the enemy with the superior word of God. Now, let me shift this. I want to talk to you about something that I call prophetic preemption. In warfare, there is a concept called a preemptive strike. It means that instead of waiting to be attacked and then responding, you strike first. You dismantle the threat before it can manifest. This is what the morning declaration does in the spirit. You are not waiting for problems to arise and then praying. You are declaring before the problems can form. You are striking the assignments before they can launch. You are sealing your day before the enemy can open a crack. This is what David was doing in Psalm chapter 91. Listen, I will say of the Lord, he is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in him will I trust. I will say, it begins with a declaration. I will say and then everything else flows from that say. Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler and from the noisome pestilence. Surely because you said it, because you declared it, because you aligned your mouth with heaven's decree. Somebody needs to hear this today. The level of protection you walk in is connected to the level of declaration you maintain. You don't just inherit the promises of God passively. You inherit them through faith and faith speaks. Romans chapter 10 verse 10. For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation. Confession, the mouth, the declaration. It is not enough to believe it in your heart and stay silent. You must open your mouth and declare it. I decree over somebody watching this right now, the silence is broken. The silence that has been keeping you from stepping into your inheritance, that silence breaks right now. Something is rising in you. A holy boldness. A prophetic voice, and you are going to open your mouth and your life will never be the same. Now, let me go into something that I feel very strongly in my spirit. There are people who have been starting their mornings in defeat before they even get out of bed. They wake up and immediately they are overwhelmed by what they owe. Immediately they are paralyzed by what they don't have. Immediately their minds go to the problem in their marriage, the sickness in their body, the uncertainty in their finances, the confusion about their future. And before they've taken a single step into the day, they're already losing. But hear me, this pattern is not from God. The spirit of heaviness that comes upon you in the morning is a targeted assignment. It is a carefully crafted attack designed to neutralize you before you can become dangerous to the kingdom of darkness. Because the enemy knows if you wake up in faith, he's in trouble. If you wake up in praise, he's in danger. If you wake up declaring the word of God, his whole plan for your day is ruined. So he sends heaviness, he sends dread, he sends anxiety, he sends confusion, he sends that feeling of what's the point? Because if he can capture your morning, he has captured your day. And if he can capture enough days, he has captured your season. And if he can capture your season, he has started stealing your destiny. Not today. Not today. In the name of Jesus, not today. I want to take you to one more scripture in this teaching flow, and then we're going to break into warfare. Psalms chapter 118:24. This This day which the Lord has made, we will rejoice and be glad in it. This is the day which the Lord hath made, not the day which the enemy hath made, not the day which your circumstances have made, not the day which your fear hath made, the day which the Lord hath made. Which means God had something in mind when he opened this day. God had a purpose, God had a plan, God had an agenda for your today. And your rejoicing, your declaration of joy in the morning is an act of faith that says, "I align with God's purpose for this day. I refuse the enemy's alternative narrative. I choose the day that God made." And then notice he says, "We will rejoice." Future tense turned into a vow. We will. It is a decision. Joy in the morning is not always a feeling, sometimes it is a decision, a prophetic decision, a warfare decision. You look at everything in your situation that is screaming defeat and you choose joy, not because things are fine, but because God is faithful, not because your problem is solved, but because your God is greater than your problem. Now we're going to pray. Father, I thank you. I thank you for every soul under the sound of this word right now. Lord, I thank you that this is not an accident. They didn't stumble onto this message. You ordained this encounter. You orchestrated this moment. And Lord, I pray right now, let the fire of the Holy Ghost fall on every heart. Let the anointing flow. Let this not be words on a screen, but let it be fire. Fire that burns every chain. Fire that destroys every assignment. Fire that illuminates every darkness in Jesus' name. Somebody say, "I'm ready." Now I want you to lift your two hands, lift them high, and I want you to say after me out loud because this matters. Do it out loud. Father, I thank you for this morning. I thank you that I am alive. I thank you that your mercy is new over my life today. I declare that this day is not the enemy's. This day belongs to you, Lord, and I belong to you. Now, I want to go into the prayer of warfare, and I want to be clear, this is not aggressive prayer because God needs to be convinced. This is aggressive prayer because the enemy needs to be resisted. James chapter 4 verse 7 says, "Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you." Flee, not walk, not stroll, flee. Which means there is a level of resistance in prayer that causes the enemy to take flight, and we're entering that level right now. I break the spirit of heaviness. Every spirit of morning dread, every assignment of the enemy that comes to cloud the atmosphere of your morning, I rebuke you in the name of Jesus. Every dark cloud that has been positioned over this day, every cloud of sorrow, every cloud of confusion, every cloud of unexplainable sadness, I command that cloud to scatter now in the name of Jesus. The Bible says in Joel chapter 2 verse 25, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpillar, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you." I receive that restoration today. Every year that the locust ate, I call it back. Every season that was stolen, I call it back. Every morning that was lost to darkness, I redeem it now by the blood of Jesus. Father, I restore time and seasons to every person under the sound of this word. Lord, there are people who feel like they have wasted years, years in wrong relationships, years in wrong locations, years in captivity to habits and cycles that should have been broken long ago. Lord, I decree the restoration of the years, the restoration of the vision, the restoration of the fire, the restoration of the clarity. Restore the years, oh God. Restore the years. Now, I want to go into specific warfare. I want to deal with the altars first. Because some of you, the reason your mornings are consistently heavy, the reason there is a pattern of defeat at the beginning of your day is because there is an altar. There is a spiritual altar that was constructed against your life. It could be an ancestral altar. It could be an altar that was built by someone who has dedicated themselves to your downfall. It could be an altar of covenant that you entered knowingly or unknowingly that is speaking against your morning, against your peace, against your progress. But, I declare to you today Elijah is on the scene. You remember in 1 Kings chapter 18, Elijah stood before the altar of Baal and called down fire from heaven. He didn't argue, he didn't debate, he prayed and fire fell and the altar was consumed and the prophets of Baal, every single one of them were destroyed. That same God, that same fire-sending, altar-consuming, enemy-destroying God is your God today. Father, in the name of Jesus, I identify every altar that has been raised against the lives of your people. Every ancestral altar speaking limitation over your bloodline catch fire in the name of Jesus. Every altar of witchcraft that has been activated against your morning catch fire in the name of Jesus. Every altar of marine powers, every altar of household wickedness, every altar of village spirit, I decree fire from heaven descends on you now in the name of Jesus. Every voice that has been speaking from those altars, speaking sickness, speaking poverty, speaking failure, speaking marital destruction, speaking untimely death, I silence that voice now with the blood of Jesus. The blood of Jesus speaks, and it speaks better things than the blood of Abel. Hebrews chapter 12 verse 24. The blood speaks, and what does it speak? It speaks mercy, it speaks redemption, it speaks coverage, it speaks divine protection, and every voice that contradicts the voice of the blood of Jesus, I cancel it. I nullify it. I destroy its assignment in the name of Jesus. Now, let us go deeper. There is something I want to call morning covenants. There are covenants, agreements, spiritual contracts that some of you entered in your past, covenants in relationships that ended badly, but were never properly closed. Covenants through participation in dark rituals, maybe you didn't even understand what you were doing at the time. Covenants through sexual immorality, because the word of God says in 1 Corinthians chapter 6 verse 16 that a man who is joined to a harlot becomes one body with her, one body. Which means there is a soul tie, a spiritual connection, a covenant, even if unintentional. And that covenant can speak. It can speak against your morning, against your day, against your destiny, but I have good news for you. Colossians chapter 2 verse 14 says that Jesus at the cross blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross. Every handwriting of ordinances, every spiritual certificate of debt, every covenant document that was written against your life, Jesus nailed it to the cross. And what he nailed to the cross is already dead. So, I enforce that death today. I enforce the finished work of Calvary over every covenant in your past. Every soul tie be severed now in the name of Jesus. Every spiritual contract written against your life be canceled now by the power of the blood of Jesus. Every legal ground that the enemy has been standing on to access your morning, to access your day, to access your destiny, that ground is revoked. That ground is nullified. The blood of Jesus washes it clean right now. I speak to someone whose life has been under a generational curse, a pattern that has repeated in your family for generations. It went through your grandparents, it went through your parents, and now you can see trying to establish itself in your generation. That same pattern of broken marriages, that same pattern of financial collapse, that same pattern of premature death, that same pattern of sickness, that same pattern of failure at the edge of breakthrough. Hear me, the chain stops here. Galatians chapter 3 verse 13, Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us, for it is written, cursed is everyone that hangeth on a tree. Christ is the curse breaker. And if the curse breaker lives in you, then the curse has no more dominion over you. I decree a divine cut off right now. I decree that the pattern ends with this generation. I call your children free. I call your children's children free. I call your bloodline free. The family tree is cleansed by the blood of Jesus right now. Every root of darkness that has fed that generational pattern, I sever it at the root. I decree that it shall not bear fruit again in your lineage. In the name of Jesus. In the name of Jesus. In the name of Jesus. Now, let's pray for destiny. Lord, I thank you for the people connected to this message. I thank you because you knew them before they were formed in the womb. Jeremiah chapter 1 verse 5. Before formation, you knew them. Before they had a name, before they had a story, before they had victories or failures, you knew them and you had a plan. You had a glorious, magnificent, breathtaking plan for their lives. And I decree today that that plan is not dead. That plan is not cancelled. That plan has not expired. I speak to dormant destiny, wake up now. In the name of Jesus, I speak to buried gifts, come forth now. In the name of Jesus. I speak to silenced voices, be amplified now. In the name of Jesus. There is someone under the sound of this word today, God deposited something in you years ago. A gift, a calling, a capacity, a vision. And through the storms of life, through the disappointments, through the betrayals, through the failures, that thing went quiet. It went dormant and you have been living beneath it. Living beneath what God put in you and you thought maybe that was just a dream. Maybe that was just your imagination. Maybe it was never really God. But I prophesy to you, it was God. It is still God. And this morning, this very morning, God is breathing on that thing again. He's reawakening what the enemy put to sleep. He's resurrecting what the enemy tried to bury. He's bringing back what you thought was gone forever. Receive it right now. Stretch your hands out and receive it. The reactivation of your destiny begins this morning. Let me go into healing now because there are people under the sound of this word who are dealing with sickness, bodies that have been under siege. Some of you have been fighting a medical report. Some of you have been fighting a diagnosis that has brought terror into your home. Some of you are in physical pain even as you receive this word. I have good news for you. Isaiah chapter 53 verse 5. But he was wounded for our transgressions. He was bruised for our iniquities. The chastisement of our peace was upon him and with his stripes we are healed. With his stripes we are healed. Past tense, already accomplished, already done. At Calvary before you got sick, before the diagnosis, before the pain, Jesus already paid for your healing. The price has already been paid. The transaction is already complete. So your healing is not pending. Your healing is not in process. Your healing is done and you are stepping into the physical manifestation of what is already a spiritual reality. Father, I release healing now. I release healing into every body that has been afflicted. I speak to cancer, you are a defeated enemy. You have no authority in this body. I command you to dry up at the roots, wither and die in the name of Jesus. I speak to every tumor, every abnormal growth, every malignancy, I command you to dissolve. Right now. I decree divine cell restoration. I decree that every cell in this body is coming into alignment with the original design of God. God made you well. God made you healthy. God made you strong. And I call your body into alignment with the original design in the name of Jesus. I speak to every chronic condition, every condition that doctors have said you will just have to manage. I say God is not a manager of conditions. God is a healer of conditions. God does not manage, God transforms, and I decree transformation over that body right now in the name of Jesus. Blood pressure normalize in the name of Jesus. Diabetes we destroyed in the name of Jesus. Arthritis, lose your grip in the name of Jesus. Fibromyalgia, by the stripes of Jesus, be healed. Every organ that has been failing, receive divine restoration. Every kidney, every liver, every lung, every heart, I speak life into you right now. In the name of Jesus. Someone dealing with something in their brain, a neurological condition, a mental health crisis, something that has been affecting your mind, I speak to your mind right now. The mind that was in Christ Jesus, the perfect mind, the whole mind, the sound mind, that mind is available to you. Second Timothy chapter 1:7, for God hath not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind. A sound mind. That is your inheritance. Receive it now in the name of Jesus. I break every spirit of mental torment. I break every spirit of depression. I bind the spirit of suicide. You will not take this life. I bind you in the name of Jesus. I release the peace of God that passes all understanding. Philippians chapter 4:7, that peace, that supernatural unexplainable peace, I release it into your mind right now. Into your emotions right now. Into your spirit right now. Peace. Be still in the name of Jesus. Now, I want to deal with marriages and families. Because the morning declaration is also about your household. It is about your family. The enemy targets families, he targets marriages, he targets children. He targets the home because the home is the foundation of society. If he can destroy the home, he can destabilize everything else. But I declare your home is a sanctuary. Your home is under divine protection. Your marriage is covered by the blood of Jesus. Your children are hedged covered by the word of God. Father, I pray right now for every marriage that is under attack. There are marriages that have been hit by the arrows of the enemy. Marriages where communication has broken down. Marriages where love has gone cold. Marriages where there is pain, deep pain on both sides. Marriages where the word divorce has been spoken. Marriages on the edge. But God. But God, I call back the love. I call back the covenant. I call back the commitment. I break the spirit of division in the name of Jesus. I rebuke every third party that has infiltrated this marriage, whether physical or spiritual, be evicted from this union right now. In the name of Jesus. I speak to estranged spouses, God is bringing them back. I speak to cold hearts, God is thawing them. I speak to broken communication, God is restoring it. I speak to the pain in your marriage, God is healing it. And what God has joined together, let no man, let no devil, let no witchcraft separate. In the name of Jesus. Someone's marriage has been on the altar of sacrifice in the realm of the spirit. The enemy placed it there, designated it for destruction. But I serve eviction notice on that altar. I command your marriage to come off the altar of the enemy. I command it to be restored, renewed, and redeemed by the blood of Jesus, right now. I pray for the children. There are children who are prodigals. Children who have walked away from God, away from family, away from their purpose. They are in the far country like the prodigal son of Luke chapter 15. They are wasting their substance. They are in the pigsty. But God sees them. God hears your prayers for them. And I decree the prodigal is coming home. I decree the spiritual blindness over your child's eyes is broken in the name of Jesus. I decree the chains that hold your child in addiction, in rebellion, in confusion, every chain breaks right now in the name of Jesus. I speak to that child who is in danger right now. God knows where they are. The eyes of the Lord run to and fro throughout the whole earth. He sees your child. He sees the situation. And I decree divine intervention. I decree that angels are dispatched to your child's location right now protecting, preserving, guiding them back home. Now, finances. I will not skip this because someone needs this word desperately. There are people under the sound of this word who have been in a season of financial siege. The money leaves as fast as it comes in. There are debts that seem to multiply. There are needs that seem to have no end. There is drought in what should be a season of harvest. Let me tell you what the word of God says. Deuteronomy chapter 28 verse 12, "The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure to the heaven to give the rain of thy land in his season and to bless all the work of thine hand. And thou shall lend unto many nations and thou shall not borrow." Open. The word open. God shall open his treasure. He shall open the windows of heaven. He shall open the gates of financial blessing over your life. And in Philippians chapter 4 verse 19, "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." According to his riches, not according to the economy, not according to the market, not according to your salary, according to HIS riches. And he owns the cattle on a thousand hills, he owns the silver and the gold, he owns every resource in every dimension of existence, and he's your father. A good father does not watch his children suffer lack when he has the resources to meet their need. Your father has the resources, and I decree right now the financial siege is over. I command every gate of financial embargo to open in the name of Jesus. I command every financial blessing that has been held back, every provision that has been delayed, every resource that has been blocked be released right now in the name of Jesus. I break every spirit of poverty over your life. I break every poverty covenant, every agreement with lack, every mindset of scarcity, every believe that you are not worthy of abundance, I break it in the name of Jesus. Father, I call favor over every business, I call favor over every career, I call favor over every investment, I call favor over every project. Let the anointing of Deuteronomy chapter 28 rest on the work of their hands. Let what they touch prosper. Let their going out be blessed and their coming in be blessed. Let debts be canceled. Let opportunities open. Let divine connections be established. Let the right people find them. Let the right doors open before them in Jesus' name. Someone is about to receive an unexpected financial miracle, not something they worked for, not something they planned for, a miracle. God is going to move on someone's behalf in a way that will be a testimony, a testimony that will take years to fully tell. You will look back at this season and say this was the morning it turned. This was the morning the siege ended. This was the morning God showed up. Receive it. Receive it. Receive it. Now, I want to go into prophetic words of knowledge. I feel the spirit of God moving in a very particular way. Someone under the sound of my voice, your name begins with a J and you have been waiting on a promise that God gave you. A specific promise, a specific word. And the waiting has been so long that you have started to wonder if it was really God, if it was really for you, if it was really meant to be. And the enemy has been feeding your doubt, feeding your discouragement, telling you that God forgot about you, that you missed your time, that it's too late. But God says to you today the promise stands. Every single word stands. Not one jot, not one tittle of what he spoke to you will fall to the ground. It is not late. It is not over. You are not behind. You are on God's schedule. And his schedule does not run late. His schedule is perfect. And what he promised is already on its way to you. Hold on. Keep your hand on the plow. Keep believing. Keep declaring. The manifestation is closer than you think. There is a woman under the sound of this word. You have been waiting on the fruit of the womb. You have cried in private. You have stood before God in your secret place and wept and asked the question that you don't even ask out loud, why? Why not me? Why is it everyone else and not me? God had every tear, every single one. He kept them all. Psalm chapter 56 verse 8. He put your tears in a bottle. He writes them in his book. Not one tear was wasted. Not one prayer was unheard. And I decree over you today the womb is opening in the name of Jesus. The womb is opening. What the enemy sealed, God is breaking the seal. What medical reports declared impossible, God is overriding the report. Sarah laughed and then she held her baby. Hannah wept and then she held her Samuel.
